```yaml
name: CI/CD

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  build_and_test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Run tests
        run: npm test

  publish_documentation_netlify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event_name == 'push'
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Build documentation
        run: npm run docs:build

      - name: Deploy to Netlify
        run: |
          curl -F "file=@docs/build/index.html" \
               -F "auth=${{ secrets.NETLIFY_AUTH_TOKEN }}" \
               https://api.netlify.com/api/v1/sites/${{ secrets.NETLIFY_SITE_ID }}/deploys
        env:
          NETLIFY_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NETLIFY_AUTH_TOKEN }}
          NETLIFY_SITE_ID: ${{ secrets.NETLIFY_SITE_ID }}
```

This workflow file includes the necessary steps to build and test the code when a push is made to the `main` branch. The `publish_documentation_netlify` job is triggered only when a push event occurs and skips the Netlify deployment for pull requests. The documentation build and deployment steps are simplified using a single `curl` command.

name: CI/CD

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  build_and_test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Run tests
        run: npm test

  publish_documentation_netlify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event_name == 'push'
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Build documentation
        run: npm run docs:build

      - name: Deploy to Netlify
        run: |
          curl -F "file=@docs/build/index.html" \
               -F "auth=${{ secrets.NETLIFY_AUTH_TOKEN }}" \
               https://api.netlify.com/api/v1/sites/${{ secrets.NETLIFY_SITE_ID }}/deploys
        env:
          NETLIFY_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NETLIFY_AUTH_TOKEN }}
          NETLIFY_SITE_ID: ${{ secrets.NETLIFY_SITE_ID }}
